name: SDSS J073728.45+321618.5 (Hubble)
blurb: SDSS J073728.45+321618.5, a gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: gal054151959145-hubble
story: A massive early-type galaxy acts as a gravitational lens here, its gravity magnifying the light of a fainter, more distant galaxy behind it. It was found by the Sloan Lens ACS Survey, which Hubble used to map the mass in distant lens galaxies.

claims.text: Archive target GAL-0541-51959-145 is the SLACS system SDSS J073728.45+321618.5, confirmed as a lens
The lensed source is more distant than the lens galaxy
SLACS lenses are massive early-type galaxies lensing fainter background sources
The program's targets are background sources magnified by a massive early-type lens galaxy
Hubble imaged these lenses to map the mass in distant lens galaxies
The survey is named the Sloan Lens ACS Survey
